sections.title: Explanation
sections.content: Fizet means 'to pay'. In the first person it's fizetek (I pay / I'm paying) — a regular verb form, unlike the ik-verbs you'll meet later.

items.spanish: Kérek egy kiló húst és egy liter vizet.
items.english: I'd like one kilo of meat and one litre of water.

sections.content: Rendben (okay/all right) is a handy filler word to accept a price before you say Fizetek.
